brand.name: hōly®
brand.logo_spec: Lowercase 'holy' with a floating halo over the 'o' and a registered trademark symbol ®. On colored backgrounds, use cream/white.

primary.usage: Display, hero titles, giant CTAs, manifesto numbers
primary.rules: Always uppercase. Apply negative letter-spacing (`tracking-tighter` or `tracking-tight`) for sizes larger than `text-4xl`.

secondary.usage: Body, UI elements, labels, buttons, accordion text
secondary.rules: Clean, highly legible. Do not use Anton for anything smaller than section headings or decorative elements.

visual_enhancers.noise_texture: SVG overlay with `feTurbulence` (type='fractalNoise', baseFrequency='0.8', numOctaves='3', stitchTiles='stitch'). Apply to `.noise-overlay` wrapper with `fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-40 mix-blend-overlay z-50`. Use faint opacity on dark sections.
visual_enhancers.badges: Outline style. Labels: '100% Natural', 'Alto en Fibra', 'Libre Azúcar Añadida'. Thin borders, uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs.
visual_enhancers.borders: Fine 1px dividers (`border-[#9c8f79]/30` or similar low-contrast muted coffee) for FAQ and list sections.

hero_coverflow.behavior: Center item large and clear. Lateral items scaled down, `blur(2px)`, `opacity: 0.85`. Fourth item hidden, `blur(4px)`. Transform-origin: center bottom. Height: 62vh desktop / 42vh mobile. Auto-advance every 5s. Pause on hover.
hero_coverflow.controls: Circular buttons with white borders for Next/Prev (‹ ›).

elements.cta_add: White pill button 'Agregar' on the active product card.
elements.kicker_left: Bottom-left fixed: 'PRODUCTOS HECHOS CON DÁTIL' (small) + Anton Title + Description.
elements.giant_cta_right: Bottom-right fixed: Giant Anton 'VER VARIEDADES' + arrow. Triggers smooth scroll to products section.

cart_drawer.features: Quantity controls, total calculated in CLP, WhatsApp ordering integration, and contact form.

masonry_gallery.usage: Consumption situations (lifestyle). Include hover zoom effects.

faq_accordion.style: Max-width ~720px. Fine dividers. Toggle icon: + / - in terracotta color.
faq_accordion.typography: Question in Inter 600, Answer in Inter 400 (muted coffee color).

marquee.behavior: Very slow, smooth drift. Anton font, outline or solid depending on background contrast. Text: '100% NATURAL • SIN AZÚCAR AÑADIDA • HŌLY® • '.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous editorial spacing. Sections should have at least `py-24` or `py-32` on desktop.
grids_and_layouts.containers: Use max-w-7xl for standard sections, but allow hero and marquee to break out (full width).
grids_and_layouts.product_grid: Tetris or Bento grid approach for 'encuentra el tuyo' category section.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Implement `@studio-freight/react-lenis` at the root layout. This is MANDATORY for the Awwwards feel.

reveals.masked_text: Wrap lines of text in `overflow-hidden`. Animate child from `y: 100%` to `y: 0` using Framer Motion on initial load or `whileInView`.
reveals.staggered_cards: Use Framer Motion `variants` to stagger children (products, manifesto chapters) entering the viewport.

hover_effects.cards: Dark cards: hover translateY(-4px) and bg change to #453a2e.

motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle Framer Motion `useScroll` and `useTransform` on the active hero packshot to give a 3D float effect when scrolling down.

accessibility.reduced_motion: Ensure `prefers-reduced-motion` pauses the 5s hero auto-advance and disables aggressive parallax.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets AA contrast over its respective background. Use terracotta for accents, not primary text.

hero_products.description: Stacked homemade oatmeal cookies in a glass jar
Hand holding a healthy snack bar in wrapper

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: Install `@studio-freight/react-lenis`, `framer-motion`, `react-fast-marquee`, `lucide-react`, and any needed Shadcn components (accordion, sheet/drawer, form).

GLOBAL CSS & FONTS: Import Anton and Inter from Google Fonts. Set up root CSS variables for the exact palette requested. Add the `.noise-overlay` class with SVG `feTurbulence` as a fixed top-level element.
ROUTING: Set up React Router. Create the Landing Page (`/`) and a dynamic Product Route (`/producto/:slug`).

HERO IMPLEMENTATION: Create a state `activeIndex` for the 4 products. Tie the background color of the hero wrapper to a mapping of `activeIndex -> Color`. Implement the coverflow math using Framer Motion (scale, x-offset, blur, z-index based on distance from activeIndex).
MASKED REVEALS: Build a reusable `<MaskedText>` component that splits text into lines, wraps them in `overflow: hidden`, and animates the inner element from `y: '100%'` to `0`.
PRODUCT PAGE: Implement the `/producto/:slug` view. It needs a flavor selector that updates the main product image and UI accent color.
CART DRAWER: Implement a right-side Shadcn Sheet for the cart. Use #1b1b1b as background. Include a WhatsApp checkout button and contact form toggle.
MASONRY & FAQ: Build the lifestyle masonry grid and the FAQ accordion. Ensure the accordion uses the exact terracotta color for the +/- icons.
FOOTER: Dark column footer (#2b2620 background), copyright '© 2026 hōly®'.
universal_guidelines: NEVER use generic fonts for headings. Always Anton.
NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds if content scrolls beneath. Use #2b2620 or #F6F1E7 solids.
ALWAYS implement smooth scroll (Lenis) and parallax elements for the Awwwards-level feel.
DO NOT add emojis as icons. Use Lucide or SVG.
Prioritize optical alignment and generous whitespace. Cramped layouts ruin the premium feel.
